sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Sarvesh Kumar Dubey, Devesh Vikram Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Umesh Chandra Sharma, J.
Heard Sri Sarvesh Kumar Dubey, learned counsel for the applicants, Shri Pankaj Tripathi, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants for quashing the summoning order dated 24.12.2019 as well as Criminal Case No. 48754 of 2019 (State Vs. Aseem Khan and Others) arising out of Case Crime No. 182 of 2018, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. & Sections 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Karnalgaj, District- Kanpur Nagar.

entities.text: Criminal Case No. 48754 of 2019 (State Vs. Aseem Khan and Others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It has been contended by the learned counsel for the applicants that there is matrimonial dispute between the son of applicants No.1 & 2, who are father-in-law and mother-in-law of the informant and due to which the aforesaid case has been filed, in which only general allegations against applicants have been levelled, which have not been substantiated by any evidence whatsoever collected during the investigation.
The applicant nos. 3 & 4 are sister-in-law and brother-in-law (Nanad & Nandoi) of the informant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned A.G.A. for the State has opposed the prayer for quashing the entire criminal proceeding on the ground that it is not the stage to look into the disputed questions of facts and evidence.
Therefore, the the same is not liable to be quashed.

In view of the facts and circumstances of the case, prayer for quashing the entire criminal proceeding in respect of applicant No.1 & 2, who are the father-in-law and mother-in-law of opposite party no.2 is refused.

It is provided that in case they appear before the court concerned within four weeks from today and move application for bail, the same shall be considered and disposed of in terms of the guidelines / observations given by Hon'ble The Apex Court in the case of Satendra Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in ( 2021) 10 SCC 773.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in ( 2021) 10 SCC 773
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: So far as applicants No.3 to 4 are concerned, it has been contended by learned counsel for the applicants that they are married sister-in-laws of opposite party no.2 and the allegations levelled against them are wholly vague and no specific allegation has been levelled against them.

Learned counsel for the applicants has placed reliance on the judgement of the Apex Court in the case of Geeta Mehrotra Vs. State of U.P. and others reported in 2012 (10) ADJ 464 and Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonam vs The State Of Bihar, decided on 8 February, 2022.

entities.text: Geeta Mehrotra Vs. State of U.P. and others reported in 2012 (10) ADJ 464
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonam vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of above, the matter requires consideration in respect of applicants No.3 to 4 only.

Notice on behalf of opposite party no.1 has been accepted by learned A.G.A.
Issue notice to opposite party no.2, returnable at an early date.
Let counter affidavit be filed within four weeks.
A week's thereafter shall be available to learned counsel for the applicants to file rejoinder affidavit.
Put up this case as fresh on 12.4.2023.
Till the next date of listing, proceedings of the aforesaid case in respect of applicants No.3 to 4 only shall remain stayed.

The application with respect of applicant nos. 1 & 2 stands disposed of.
Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Vinod.

Per contra, learned A.G.A. for the State has opposed the prayer for quashing the entire criminal proceeding on the ground that it is not the stage to look into the disputed questions of facts and evidence.

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
Therefore, the the same is not liable to be quashed.
In view of the facts and circumstances of the case, prayer for quashing the entire criminal proceeding in respect of applicant No.1 & 2, who are the father-in-law and mother-in-law of opposite party no.2 is refused.
So far as applicants No.3 to 4 are concerned, it has been contended by learned counsel for the applicants that they are married sister-in-laws of opposite party no.2 and the allegations levelled against them are wholly vague and no specific allegation has been levelled against them.

In view of above, the matter requires consideration in respect of applicants No.3 to 4 only.
Notice on behalf of opposite party no.1 has been accepted by learned A.G.A.

A week's thereafter shall be available to learned counsel for the applicants to file rejoinder affidavit.
Put up this case as fresh on 12.4.2023.
Till the next date of listing, proceedings of the aforesaid case in respect of applicants No.3 to 4 only shall remain stayed.
